options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: Keep the console's own picture shape, or stretch it to fill the screen.

options.label: Integer scaling
options.description: Only enlarge the picture by whole steps, so every pixel has the same size. Leaves borders around it.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: Sharp keeps crisp square pixels; Smooth blurs them slightly when the picture is enlarged.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Wait for the screen between frames: no tearing.

options.label: Show frame rate
options.description: RetroArch shows the frames per second on screen.

notes: retroarch.cfg is RetroArch's own settings file: `key = "value"` lines, no sections (section ""), every value quoted; RetroArch rewrites it whole on exit (config_save_on_exit), keeping these keys. Keys and values from RetroArch 1.22.2 configuration.c and gfx/video_defines.h.

aspect_ratio_index is enum aspect_ratio: 22 ASPECT_RATIO_CORE (the core's own shape), 24 ASPECT_RATIO_FULL (the whole screen). video_scale_integer, video_smooth (bilinear), video_vsync and fps_show are booleans.

Left out: renderer (Vulkan for every core here; N64 will need GL, Phase 6), resolution and widescreen_hack (no such setting for these 2D consoles), shaders (armGBA's LCD presets: later). Core options (armGBA's BIOS choice, Genesis Plus GX's region) stay in RetroArch's Quick Menu > Core Options.
